description: This file implements the procedures for configuring DU (Distributed Unit) parameters in a 5G network, including validation of requests, handling cell configuration updates, and initiating reconfiguration processes.

classes.name: du_param_config_procedure
classes.description: Class responsible for handling DU parameter configuration requests, including validation, updating cell configs, and triggering network reconfiguration.

methods.name: validate_du_param_config_request
methods.description: Validates the DU parameter configuration request, ensuring required fields are present based on the number of cells.

methods.name: du_param_config_procedure
methods.description: Constructor initializing the procedure with request data, DU parameters, and cell manager.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main execution method that performs validation, updates, and triggers reconfiguration asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_cell_config_updates
methods.description: Handles updating cell configurations based on the request, either broadcasting to all or specific cells.

methods.name: handle_f1_gnbdu_config_update
methods.description: Initiates F1AP gNB-DU configuration update for changed cells.

methods.name: handle_mac_cell_update
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration of individual MAC cells based on changes.
